decisions.reason: As a visible own-page launch that extends the firm’s core data and calculation capabilities, it is likely still above aspiration under early-market uncertainty and worth retaining.
This product is close to the established offer, uses existing market-data resources, and in a growing industry a medium-sized firm with some slack would usually give it more time.
Its close fit with the firm’s tariff and billing focus and its standalone web presence suggest acceptable prospects, though some overlap with other tariff tools raises a modest review risk.

Because it was only mentioned rather than strongly presented and appears redundant with other tariff-calculation products, management would be more likely to reallocate resources if results fell short of aspiration.
The tool supports the firm’s platform-expansion path and complements other regional and tariff applications, so boundedly rational management would likely continue it while outcomes remain uncertain.

Its limited web prominence and strong similarity to other comparison offerings make it the clearest candidate for problemistic search and resource redeployment into stronger products or new development.
